speaker: Deepak Chopra
sourceBasis: The official homepage identifies Chopra as a physician and author and describes his work on spiritual wisdom, science, meditation, self-awareness and well-being.
proposedText: Deepak Chopra is a physician and author whose books and public teaching explore spirituality, meditation, consciousness, and well-being. His work connects spiritual traditions with questions about science, self-awareness, and the relationship between mind and body.
